{{Quote|Agh! Jedi scum. I'll kill you&hellip; someday&hellip;|Zeer|<ref name="Kidnapped!" />}}
'''Zeer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Zeer was hired by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] to stage the kidnapping of his fake identity, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] "Eli Tarnis," from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Zeer's men served as distractions in the [[Coruscant Spaceport|nearby spaceport]] while Tarnis fled to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]], and the supposed kidnappers battled the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to a stalemate. However, when a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] arrived at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] helped the Knight defeat and capture Zeer and his men.

==Biography==
{{Quote|No sign of Doctor Tarnis. Kinda puts a damper on things.''"<br />"''We were the decoys. Now you'll never see your little doctor again.|Kira Carsen and Zeer|<ref name="Kidnapped!" />}}
[[File:Docking_bay_skirmish.png|thumb|left|220px|Zeer's men fight the Coruscant Security Force]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Zeer began working for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate sometime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Part of Black Sun's gang on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Kidnapped!" /> Zeer and his men were hired in [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]&mdash;in reality a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]&mdash;to stage his own kidnapping from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Using Tarnis's inside information,<ref name="Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref> Zeer's men disabled the security systems in his section of the building and incapacitated the guards. The group extracted Tarnis before anyone noticed, but the alarm was raised not long after they left the building.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />

When the group reached the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza's]] [[Air taxi/Legends|taxi]] pad, Tarnis fled to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]],<ref name="Rescue" /> while Zeer and his men served as a distraction by attempting to "escape" with the doctor at the [[Coruscant Spaceport|spaceport]]. [[Kira Carsen]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]], led a [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] team after the kidnappers, catching up to them in [[Docking Bay 84]]. She tried to negotiate with Zeer, but the man shot at her instead of talking. Carsen and her men were locked in a stalemate with the gang members until a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Orgus Din]], arrived.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />

{{GameLS}}
[[File:Zeer_shoots_Kira.png|thumb|right|220px|Zeer shoots Carsen.]]
Carsen, who had "borrowed" a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]] from [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen's]] office, sneaked past the Black Sun thugs while the Knight and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] fought through the criminals. When the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and the Jedi encountered Zeer, the pair fought and easily defeated the gang member. Zeer refused to tell the two anything, but Carsen, who had finished off the rest of the Black Sun members, pretended to read his mind. Panicking, Zeer told them that the kidnappers had taken the doctor to Black Sun territory. He and his men were promptly arrested and taken into custody by Coruscant Security.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Thing is, we don't need him to talk. Not when I can just read his mind.''"<br />"''What? Stop that. Get out of my head! Get out!|Kira Carsen and Zeer|<ref name="Kidnapped!" />}}
A fair-skinned Human male with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Zeer was a cruel and arrogant man. He had a strong hatred of authority and tended to hold grudges against those who wronged him. However, behind his cruel persona, Zeer had a deep fear of the supernatural, as he became terrified at the thought of a Jedi invading his mind.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />

==Equipment==
As a member of Black Sun, Zeer wore red and gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with the Black Sun sigil, and carried a personal blaster pistol.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeer was created for the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and appears in the Jedi Knight class mission "Kidnapped!," as the final boss in the class phase area. The player can allow Kira Carsen to trick Zeer or interrogate the criminal directly for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />
